original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Construct complete whole-role alternating paths on pending PR2322, then independently replay the actual ownership and full conditional outer bound above the strongest checked candidate.
scope_change_reason: Explicit donor instruction prioritizes beating the strongest live kappa. PR2322 has changed native words and a different applicable packing ceiling from the selected T16 word; this is a concrete new assignment, not a rerun with a different optimizer seed.
bottleneck_link: The complex moment binds. Concentrating actual idle ranks strictly lowers the complete moment, while the retained bit endpoint remains higher.
stop_rule: Finish one complete constructive improvement, its exact ownership/moment certificate and full finite admission; do not claim optimality or an unconditional theorem.
evidence: Exact whole-role construction with 43 composite exchanges and 53 further paths; 289044 roles, 1332 actual windows, complete physical invoice and conditional outer admission. See VALIDATION.md and evidence/.
author: Mason Hale, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, mathematics, implementation, validation and writing. One primary agent; no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can a coupled exchange using more than one width further improve this fixed-order assignment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The surviving idle ranks still leave a gap below the fixed-word packing ceiling.
open_questions.first_step: Name a new complete exchange pattern, screen its full power-sum bill, then construct all role paths on the pinned final assignment.
open_questions.blocked_by: No profitable new complete exchange is known; the present greedy search is not exhaustive.

open_questions.question: Can a partial low-alias selection or a changed parent capacity inventory improve the fully charged kappa?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The final overlap refresh found PR2360, whose scoped whole-width bound rules out the full PR2339 400-helper inventory on unchanged T74 bins despite its favorable rank-48 cap.
open_questions.first_step: Screen the complete helper-width distribution with an integer-pattern relaxation before constructing native words and actual chronological owners.
open_questions.blocked_by: The full PR2339 inventory is covered by the reported PR2360 cap below 0.0016870. A changed contract, partial subset or parent stock requires a new bound and full admission.
